title: A chain build replay uses a picture run that ends 3 and sets aside a brand file or mapping whose pictures are gone, saying so
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A picture run whose get ends 3 on mapping problems is still written; a brand file or picture mapping whose pictures are missing (a run older than the last deploy) is replaced by the chain's stand-in, never written half, and the replay names it in inputs.gone and a line.

tests: a run older than the last deploy has its documents but not its pictures: they are set aside and the replay says so
a picture run whose get ends 3 on mapping problems is still used, as the chain uses it
a replay writes the build's own inputs to its own trial site, then checks it, and answers as the chain does
